summary: The 8-K, filed by Hartford Funds Exchange-Traded Trust as a registrant, reports that Hartford Insurance Group (parent) and Wellington Management reached a definitive agreement under which Wellington's corporate parent will acquire Hartford Funds Management Group and affiliates. No exact price per share, stake percentage, or premium was disclosed. Upon closing, HFMG will integrate into Wellington's U.S. Wealth business. The filing is an Item 8.01 other events disclosure confirming the deal, which is an acquisition of an asset manager. The registrant is an ETF trust indirectly affected as an affiliate. No advisor or board recommendation was stated. The closing timeline was not specified. Watch for regulatory approvals and integration progress.
